content.short: FOREVER FC offers fun, competitive games built on digital collectibles linked to real life.
content.description: Millions of gamers buy in-game items that quickly become worthless or obsolete. FOREVER FC lets players trade and play with digital collectibles whose in-game performance evolves over time, creating dynamic strategies and increasing long-term value. By owning and managing these evolving assets, players can build competitive lineups, trade for advantages, and watch outcomes shift as traits change. Updates are shared across the project’s social channels.
content.meta: FOREVER FC lets you trade and play with digital collectibles whose performance changes over time. Discover FOREVER FC and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
